svg.text: Flow 04 Counter point of sale: taking payment and walk-in orders
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
An order in the Queue is
• Taking payment checks and deducts the stock before the money is kept: marking paid, deducting each dish's raw
materials (or a ready-made item's pieces) and confirming happen in one database transaction; a shortage rolls
• Cash records the cash received, for the change on the receipt. GCash and Maya are paid to the shop's own account
and recorded with the reference number from the customer's phone (no PayMongo); a reference number can be
• PARTIAL: the message asks staff to change the order with the customer, but no screen edits an existing order
(the API has endpoints to change or remove order items, unused by the web app). In practice the order is
• The Queue reloads by itself when an order is placed, paid, edited or cancelled (orders:changed). A paid order
that has to be cancelled later is Flow 11.
